content:
sam: Heads-up — customer (FinLedger) asked to onboard Quasar-13B for code-assist. They want low-latency (<= 120ms tail) and INT4 quantized footprint. Can we triage priority?
priya: @sam do we have the request payload / sample prompts they plan to use? latency target seems aggressive for 13B quantized but maybe doable with batching rules off. :thinking_face:
dylan: I have a copy of the model weights incoming via S3. Quick notes: Quasar seems to use fused rotary pos emb, kv cache shape is standard. INT4 path might need custom kernel checks on H100. :eyes:
julia: We should gate this on quality evals first. Ask them for a 1000-example eval set (mix of code completions + docstring generation). We'll run exact match & comp-sim metrics and look for regressions vs their existing provider.
sam: uploaded their sample prompts to the intake folder: s3://rl-internal/finledger/quasar13b/samples.jsonl
priya: tagging infra for GPU guidance. If they need <120ms tail we probably need H100s and continuous batching disabled, or smaller sequence lengths. What seq len are they using?
dylan: their samples average 120 tokens. With INT4 and KV cache hits, I'm optimistic. But we should benchmark both FP16 and INT4; some code tasks regress badly with aggressive quant. I'll run an A/B smoke.
infra-bot: Available capacity check: H100-p4: 6 free nodes in us-west2, A100-80GB: 2 free nodes. Quasar-13B estimated mem (FP16): 26GB, (INT4): ~8-10GB with packing.
julia: Proposed triage checklist: 1) run fp16 smoke on H100; 2) run int4 quantize + smoke; 3) run eval set -> report EM/ROUGE/CodeBLEU diffs; 4) perf microbench (p99/p50 latency at qps=2); 5) regression thresholds (EM drop <= 3% and CodeBLEU drop <= 5%); 6) determine rollout policy (canary + auto-fallback to FP16).
sam: assigning owner: @dylan take point on quant runs & perf. @julia you own eval harness & threshold decision. @priya liaison with customer for constraints. :thumbsup:
dylan: starting FP16 smoke now. Command I'll run (local):
```
python tools/run_smoke.py --model s3://models/quasar-13b/fp16 --input samples.jsonl --device h100 --batch-size 1 --seq-len 128
```
Will post logs in thread.
priya: I'll ping FinLedger for eval set and target failure modes (security/PII sensitivity) and confirm SLA.
julia: Created an eval job template: `evals/quasar13b/finledger-template.yaml`. It includes CodeBLEU, exact-match, and a few heuristic safety checks.
dylan: FP16 smoke results (summary): p50 ~ 68ms, p95 ~ 145ms, some outliers when KV miss. Throughput at qps=2 p95 ~ 160ms. Posting raw log: s3://rl-internal/finledger/quasar13b/fp16-smoke.log
sam: OK noted. p95 slightly above target. Next try INT4 and run same microbench. If INT4 p95 <=120ms and quality within thresholds, we can propose INT4 canary.
dylan: INT4 quant in progress. Using `quantize4.py --mode per-channel --calib 512` then run same smoke. If we see >6% CodeBLEU regression, I'll abort.
julia: Important: include a deterministic prompt set for regression gating. Also capture tokenization diffs (sometimes quantization affects tokenization rounding).
infra-bot: Reminder: H100 run reservation window starts in ~40 minutes. If we need sustained testing reserve a slot via infra-ticket #5043.
priya: I'll open infra-ticket if needed. Also asking customer if they can accept an FP16 fallback during peak.
sam: next steps checklist posted to thread and I'll convert to ticket for tracking. :rocket:
dylan: INT4 smoke logs uploaded: s3://rl-internal/finledger/quasar13b/int4-smoke.log — quick glance: p50 55ms, p95 118ms, CodeBLEU delta -4.1% vs their baseline (within threshold).
julia: Good sign. I'll run the full 1k eval overnight and publish a report. If it holds, we'll plan a canary rollout on a Dedicated pool with auto-fallback to FP16.
sam: thanks team. we'll reconvene once full eval is in. If anyone wants ownership handoff ping me. :white_check_mark:
